SEPH could no longer refravne manie ſtanding
by in preſente : wherupon he commanded that al
ſhould goe forth , and po ſtranger ſhould be preſent at
their acknowledging one of another. 2. And he litted
vp his voice with weeping, which the AEgyptians
heard, and al the houſc of Pharao. 2. And he ſaid to
bis Brethren : I am Ioſeph : is my father yet liuing? His brethren could
not anſwer him being terribly aſtoniſhed out ot meafutte. 4. To whom
gently he ſaid: Come hither to me. And when they were come neer
him, I am, quoth he, Ioſeph your brother, whom you fold into AEgypt.
5. Be not affraid, neither let it ſeeme to you a hard caſe that vou did ſel
me into thefe countries : tor (a) God ſent me before you into Egypt
for your preſeruation. 6. For it is two yeares ſince the famine began to
be vpon the earth, and yet fiue yeares remaine, wherin there can be
neither earing not reaping. 7. And God ſent me betore, that you may be
preſerued vpon the earth, and may haue victuals to liue. 8. Not by vout
counſail, but by the wil ot God was I ſent hither: who hath made nicas
it were a father to Pharao, and Lord of his whole houſe, and Prince in
al the land of AEgypt. 9. Make haſt and get ye vp to my father, and vou
ſhal ſay to him: Thy ſonne Ioſeph willeth thus : God hath made me Lord
of the whole land of AEgypt : come downe to me , taty not. 10. And
thou ſhalt dwel in the land of Geſſen: and thou ſhalt be neer me thou
and thy ſonnes, and thy ſonnes children, thy ſheep, and thy heards, and
al things that thon doſt poſſeſſe. 11. And there I wil feed thee (tot vet
there are fiue yeares of famine remayning) leſt both thou periſh, and
thy houſe, and al things that thou doſt poſſrſſe. 12. Behold, vour eyes
and the eyes of my brother Bentamin doe ſee, that it is my mouith that
ſpeaketh vnto vou. 12. Report to my father my whole glorie & al things
that vou haue ſeen in AEgypt: make haſt, and bring himto me. 14. And
talling vpon the neck of his brother Beniamin, embracing him he wept:
he alſo in like manner weeping vpon his neck. 15. And Ioſeph kiſſed al
